text: The corpus is 371 papers on traffic scenario generation and simulation, found with OpenAlex and arXiv searches limited to 2019 onward (a few records are older or undated, and 14 carry Crossref as a source), of which 288 had an open full text.
From those I chose 34 from their abstracts to cover different control mechanisms, and filled one row each.
